stories.headline: Meta’s Muse is creepy, but maybe not for the reasons you think
stories.dek: Meta's Muse is apparently an effective AI assistant, but one that's a little creepy. Part of that is because of its new Mac app, which can access Messages, Calendar, and Notes. But for all its smarts, Muse doesn't actually know how to describe itself. Jason Aten, a contributing editor at Inc Magazin
stories.imageCredit: Photo by Evgeniy Smersh on Unsplash
